summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Suzano S.A., a Brazilian pulp and paper company, as a foreign private issuer. The sole substantive exhibit is the company’s bylaws, which were updated or restated. There is no transaction, no change of control, no board recommendation, and no financial terms disclosed. The filing is a routine corporate governance update that does not trigger any special-situation classification. It is equivalent to a US registrant filing amended articles of incorporation under a current report, but here it is submitted on Form 6-K. No special-situation event exists.
